title: Crüger to Müller, 9 August 1622
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller of 9 August 1622, written at Danzig after he had received the fourth book of Kepler's *Epitome astronomiae Copernicanae* (1620), on the proportions of the planetary orbs and bodies. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. D. 26). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 107.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Having read the fourth book of Kepler's *Epitome* more than once, Crüger still cannot understand its proportions of the planetary orbs and bodies, and suspects Kepler of obscuring things on purpose.

notes.on: the fourth book of Kepler's Astronomy
notes.note: Book IV of the *Epitome astronomiae Copernicanae* (1620), on celestial physics.
